overview_description.description: Maquoketa Research develops autonomous unmanned aerial systems, guidance software, and control solutions for defense applications. The company designs and manufactures NDAA-compliant one-way attack drones engineered to operate in contested, GNSS-denied, and electronically jammed environments. Its hardware is integrated with custom AI edge software for computer vision target tracking and autonomous navigation on low-cost computing platforms. Maquoketa Research offers the Magpie UAS for semi-autonomous long-range strike missions and Odin ground control software for real-time telemetry, object detection overlays, and mission routing. The company also develops Synapse, a platform-agnostic terminal guidance module that runs on minimal hardware to increase mission completion rates. In addition, it supplies domestically assembled electronic speed controllers and flight controllers optimized for scaling airframe production. Maquoketa Research focuses on vertically integrated, domestic manufacturing to support military and government users with secure and scalable drone capabilities.
